description.en: Zhipu AI's MaaS platform with a permanently free GLM Flash tier (GLM-4-Flash / GLM-4.7-Flash) plus sign-up credits for paid GLM models.
description.zh-Hans: 智谱 AI 的 MaaS 平台，提供长期免费的 GLM Flash 档位（GLM-4-Flash / GLM-4.7-Flash），注册另有付费 GLM 模型的学习额度。

detail.en: Zhipu AI (智谱) offers GLM models through an OpenAI-compatible MaaS endpoint. The GLM-4-Flash text model is announced as permanently free without call-volume restrictions, and the newer GLM-4.7-Flash is also free; GLM-4V-Flash is a free image-understanding model. New accounts get learning credits for paid GLM models (community reports around 20M tokens; check the official console). Free-tier concurrency is generous but check the official rate-limit doc for current values.
detail.zh-Hans: 智谱 AI 通过兼容 OpenAI 的 MaaS 接口提供 GLM 系列模型。GLM-4-Flash 文本模型已宣布长期免费、基本不限调用量，后续推出的 GLM-4.7-Flash 同样免费；GLM-4V-Flash 是免费的图像理解模型。新账号注册会赠送可用于付费 GLM 模型的学习额度（社区反馈约 2,000 万 tokens，以官方控制台为准）。免费模型并发较高，但当前速率限制请以官方速率限制文档为准。

provider.name: Zhipu GLM
provider.desc: OpenAI-compatible MaaS endpoint for Zhipu GLM models, including free Flash tiers.
